    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">面试官问MyBatis/OpenFeign的原理？我手搓了个MyHttp怼回去！(反八股版)</span>
    

</a>

            <div class="clear"></div>

<h1>一、前言</h1>
<p>自从有了AI、大模型、DeepSeek、豆包、GPT......，就再也没写过技术文章了。毕竟，在它们面前写什么内容都是多余的。我甚至问过AI“AI 时代写技术博客还有意义吗”这个问题，它给出了如下结论：</p>
<blockquote>
<pre><span><strong>结论：</strong>AI 时代，技术博客不仅有意义，反而变得 更重要 了。
虽然 AI 能快速生成内容，但真正的价值恰恰在于人类的独特思考和实践经验，
这是 AI 无法完全复制的 "极值"（而 AI 只能产出 "平均值"）。<br><strong>行动建议：</strong>&nbsp;不要犹豫是否开始，而是思考如何将 AI 变成你的创作助手。<br>本周就选定一个小而精的技术主题，尝试 "人类构思 + AI 辅助" 的创作模式，体验效率与质量的双重提升。<br><strong>记住：</strong>在 AI 时代，最有价值的不是 "写什么"，而是 "你为什么这样写" 的独特视角。</span></pre>
</blockquote>
<p>总感觉它在一本正经的胡说八道，但又拿不出来证据，偶尔还会被它的“心灵鸡汤”戳中。有时候想想也是：</p>
<p>AI 是很牛逼，但它写不出我深夜改 bug 改到脱发的崩溃；</p>
<p>AI 是很万能，但它写不出"一个 bug 是 bug，两个 bug 是 feature"的玄学代码；</p>
<p>AI 是能给方案，但它给不出在办公室用底层原理驯服测试小姐姐的那种拿捏感。</p>
<p>以上便是今天这篇博文的引子，字里行间表达了作者对故乡的思念之情，对童年时光的怀念之情，爱国之情，对小日子的痛恨之情等等。</p>
<h1>二、背景</h1>
<p>问：MyBatis为什么写一个public interface UserMapper接口类，就能访问数据库？</p>
<p>问：OpenFeign为什么写一个public interface UserFeignClient接口类，就能发送HTTP请求？</p>
<p>此时你一脸懵逼的说：我平常项目就是这么开发的，接口会调用xml中我写好的sql，接口会调用我注解中的url地址。</p>
<p>遗憾的是，要是面试时你这么答，面试官大概率直接给你打零分 —— 他要的不是 “怎么用”，而是 “为什么能这么用”。</p>
<p>要搞懂这些问题的核心，就绕不开 “动态代理”—— 这正是面试官想考察的底层思维，咱们今天就掰烂了揉碎了说说“动态代理的那些事儿”。接下来咱们不背八股，直接手搓一个类 OpenFeign 的 “MyHttp”，把动态代理扒明白。</p>
<h1>三、手搓一个“MyHttp”</h1>
<p>我们要实现的东西暂且叫做“MyHttp”，他的目标就是像OpenFeign一样，定义一个接口就能发送HTTP请求，不需要任何配置和任何实现类。</p>
<p>我们首先来看，常规调用HTTP接口的代码大概长下面这个样子：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> RegisterResponse registerUser(RegisterUserRequest requestParam) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IOException, ParseException {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (CloseableHttpClient httpClient =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClients.createDefault()) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">构建POST请求</span>
        HttpPost httpPost = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpPost("http://localhost:8080/api/user/register");
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置请求头</span>
        httpPost.setHeader("Content-Type"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ContentType.APPLICATION_JSON.toString());
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">将请求参数序列化为JSON字符串</span>
        String requestJson =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OBJECT_MAPPER.writeValueAsString(requestParam);
        HttpEntity requestEntity </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringEntity(requestJson, ContentType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        httpPost.setEntity(requestEntity);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">执行请求，获取响应</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (CloseableHttpResponse response =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> httpClient.execute(httpPost)) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">解析响应实体</span>
            HttpEntity responseEntity =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.getEntity();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (responseEntity == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RuntimeException("注册接口返回空响应"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">将响应JSON字符串反序列化为实体类</span>
            String responseJson =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EntityUtils.toString(responseEntity);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> OBJECT_MAPPER.readValue(responseJson, RegisterResponse.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;“MyHttp”的目标是这个样子：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@HttpClient(baseUrl="http://localhost:8080/api"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserHttp {
    @HttpPost(url </span>= "/user/register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    RegisterResponse registerUser(RegisterUserRequest requestParam);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>看起来是不是很清爽？接下来我们基于动态代理一步一步实现它。</p>
<h1>四、先搞几个核心注解</h1>
<p><strong>@HttpClient：</strong>放到接口类上，表示这是一个基于“MyHttp”的接口，放一个属性baseUrl，定义这个接口下的所有HTTP调用的url根路径：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> @<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClient {
    String baseUrl() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>当然，如果你愿意，还可以扩展其它属性，比如你想设置连接超时时间、读超时时间，再比如你的baseUrl是动态的，或者是个地址列表要负载均衡去调用等等：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> @<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClient {
    String baseUrl() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;<br></span>    int connectTimeout() default -1;<br>    int readTimeout() default -1;<br><em id="__mceDel"><span>    Class</span>&lt;? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extends</span> BaseUrlSource&gt; baseUrlSource() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> BaseUrlSource.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span>; <br>} <br></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span> BaseUrlSource { <br>    List</span>&lt;String&gt;<span> getBaseUrls(); <br>}</span></em></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>@HttpPost：</strong>放在接口方法上，表示这个方法具体要调用哪个接口，报文头怎么设置，超时参数等等：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Target({ElementType.METHOD})
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> @<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpPost {
    String url() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    String contentType() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> connectTimeout() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> readTimeout() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>当然，如果你愿意，仍然可以扩展很多很多属性，但这不是本文重点。</p>
<h1>五、再实现一下InvocationHandler</h1>
<p>简单说一下InvocationHandler ：是 JDK 动态代理的 “调用处理器”，当我们通过Proxy.newProxyInstance（JDK 动态代理的核心方法，作用是 “绑定接口和代理逻辑，生成最终可用的代理对象”）的方式生成对象并调用目标方法时，JVM 会自动将调用转发到 InvocationHandler 的 invoke 方法，由该方法完成最终的方法执行 + 自定义增强逻辑。</p>
<p>翻译成人话：用 InvocationHandler 把 “被代理的接口” 包一层，生成一个 “代理对象”；之后调用接口方法时，其实是在调代理对象的方法，自然就会走进 invoke 里咱们写的逻辑。</p>
<p>以下例子中，我们便在invoke方法中拿到了被代理的接口类和接口方法，这时候我们就能拿到所有注解，进而根据注解信息组装HTTP报文并发送请求。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * HTTP动态代理处理器：拦截接口方法调用，自动发送HTTP请求
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> HttpInvocationHandler <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InvocationHandler {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> JSON序列化工具（全局复用）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> ObjectMapper OBJECT_MAPPER = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectMapper();
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> HttpClient客户端</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> CloseableHttpClient HTTP_CLIENT =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpClients.createDefault();
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 目标接口的Class对象（用于解析注解）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> Class&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targetInterface;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> HttpInvocationHandler(Class&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targetInterface) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.targetInterface =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targetInterface;
    }

    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Throwable {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析接口级@HttpClient注解，获取基础URL</span>
        HttpClient httpClientAnnotation = targetInterface.getAnnotation(HttpClient.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        String baseUrl </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> httpClientAnnotation.baseUrl();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析方法级@HttpPost注解，获取子路径</span>
        HttpPost httpPostAnnotation = method.getAnnotation(HttpPost.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        String subUrl </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> httpPostAnnotation.url();
        String contentType </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> httpPostAnnotation.contentType();
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拼接完整请求URL</span>
        String fullUrl = baseUrl +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subUrl;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">处理请求参数</span>
        String requestJson = OBJECT_MAPPER.writeValueAsString(args[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]);
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送HTTP POST请求</span>
        HttpPost httpPost = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpPost(fullUrl);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置请求头：JSON格式</span>
        httpPost.setHeader("Content-Type"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, contentType);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置请求体</span>
        HttpEntity requestEntity = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringEntity(requestJson);
        httpPost.setEntity(requestEntity);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行请求并获取响应</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (var response =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HTTP_CLIENT.execute(httpPost)) {
            HttpEntity responseEntity </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.getEntity();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析响应JSON</span>
            String responseJson =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EntityUtils.toString(responseEntity);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">响应结果反序列化为方法返回类型</span>
            Type returnType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> method.getGenericReturnType();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OBJECT_MAPPER.readValue(responseJson, OBJECT_MAPPER.constructType(returnType));
        }
    }
} </span></pre>
</div>
<h1>六、再写个代理工厂</h1>
<p>现在我们只差如何创建代理对象了，这也是最后一步，这时候我们用到了Proxy.newProxyInstance。这个方法你可以想象成：被代理对象，通过Proxy.newProxyInstance的方式与代理对象绑定了起来，这样当被代理对象的方法被调用时，实际就变成了代理对象在帮你调用，那么就会进入代理对象的invoke方法，从而执行我们的增强逻辑。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * HTTP代理工厂：封装动态代理对象的创建逻辑
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpProxyFactory {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 创建HTTP接口的代理对象
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass 目标接口Class（如UserHttp.class）
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 接口代理对象
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> &lt;T&gt; 接口类型
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> &lt;T&gt; T createProxy(Class&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建自定义InvocationHandler</span>
        HttpInvocationHandler handler = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpInvocationHandler(interfaceClass);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成动态代理对象</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (T) Proxy.newProxyInstance(
                interfaceClass.getClassLoader(), 
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Class&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]{interfaceClass},  
                handler                          
        );
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>七、核心逻辑串一串</h1>
<p>进度条走到这里，核心逻辑基本梳理完了，咱们先简单总结一下整体流程：接口注解定义 → 代理工厂创建代理对象 → 调用接口方法触发 invoke → 解析注解组装 HTTP 请求 → 响应反序列化返回。</p>
<h1>八、测试一下</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@RestController
@RequestMapping(</span>"/demo"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DemoController {
    @PostMapping(</span>"/register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RegisterResponse register(@RequestBody RegisterUserRequest request) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建UserHttp接口的代理对象</span>
        UserHttp userHttp = HttpProxyFactory.createProxy(UserHttp.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用接口方法，底层自动发送HTTP请求</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userHttp.registerUser(request);
    }
}<br></span></pre>
</div>
<p>至此，上面的实现已经能跑通，但总觉得还缺点什么？</p>
<h1>九、还缺点什么？</h1>
<p>有人说，你怎么通过UserHttp userHttp = HttpProxyFactory.createProxy(UserHttp.class);的方式才能调用？我平常项目里都是这样就能调用了：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Autowired
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> UserHttp userHttp;</pre>
</div>
<p>这里就涉及到Spring 的 FactoryBean 接口和注解扫描注册器，并不是本文重点，但还是给大家补全这个 “实战最后一公里”。</p>
<p>首先要实现FactoryBean （Spring 的 “特殊 Bean 工厂”，专门用来创建 “不是简单 new 出来” 的 Bean，比如咱们的动态代理对象）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * 自定义FactoryBean：生成HTTP接口的动态代理对象
 * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> &lt;T&gt; 目标接口类型（如UserHttp）
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> HttpProxyFactoryBean&lt;T&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span> FactoryBean&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 目标接口的Class对象</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Class&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造器注入接口类型</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> HttpProxyFactoryBean(Class&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.interfaceClass =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 创建Bean实例（返回动态代理对象）
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @Override
    @Nullable
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> T getObject() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用之前的动态代理工厂生成代理对象</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpProxyFactory.createProxy(interfaceClass);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 返回Bean的类型（接口类型）
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Class&lt;?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getObjectType() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interfaceClass;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 单例模式（代理对象复用）
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isSingleton() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后实现ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar扫描所有标记了@HttpClient的接口，自动注册为 Spring Bean：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> HttpProxyBeanRegistrar <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar {
    @Override
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> registerBeanDefinitions(AnnotationMetadata importingClassMetadata, BeanDefinitionRegistry registry) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建扫描器：只扫描标记@HttpClient的接口</span>
        ClassPathScanningCandidateComponentProvider scanner = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ClassPathScanningCandidateComponentProvider(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        scanner.addIncludeFilter(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AnnotationTypeFilter(HttpClient.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">扫描指定包，需替换为实际包名</span>
        String basePackage = "com.demo.http"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
        scanner.findCandidateComponents(basePackage).forEach(beanDefinition </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">获取接口的Class对象</span>
                String className =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> beanDefinition.getBeanClassName();
                Class</span>&lt;?&gt; interfaceClass =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClassUtils.forName(className, ClassUtils.getDefaultClassLoader());</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">构建BeanDefinition：指定Bean类型为HttpProxyFactoryBean</span>
                BeanDefinitionBuilder builder = BeanDefinitionBuilder.genericBeanDefinition(HttpProxyFactoryBean.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">构造器注入接口Class对象</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                builder.addConstructorArgValue(interfaceClass);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">注册Bean，Bean名称默认用接口类名首字母小写，如userHttp</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                registry.registerBeanDefinition(ClassUtils.getShortNameAsProperty(interfaceClass), builder.getBeanDefinition());
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ClassNotFoundException e) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RuntimeException("扫描HTTP接口失败：" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>最后别忘了关键的一步：增加一个配置类，导入自定义bean注册器</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Configuration
@Import(HttpProxyBeanRegistrar.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>)
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HttpProxyAutoConfiguration {
    
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>十、再测试一下</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@RestController
@RequestMapping(</span>"/demo"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DemoController {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">自动注入UserHttp接口</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Autowired
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserHttp userHttp;

    @PostMapping(</span>"/register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RegisterResponse register(@RequestBody RegisterUserRequest request) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用接口方法，底层自动发送HTTP请求</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userHttp.registerUser(request);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个代码，是不是就非常有感觉了。有了这一套，面试时被问 “OpenFeign 为什么能直接注入接口用”，你不光能说清动态代理，还能说清 Spring 是怎么管理这些代理 Bean 的，直接碾压八股文选手。</p>
<h1>十一、结语：手搓的意义，不止于 “会用”</h1>
<p>&nbsp;好像没啥可说的了，用AI生成一段吧：</p>
<blockquote>
<pre><span>写到这，咱们的 “MyHttp” 就彻底跑通了 —— 从注解定义到动态代理拦截，再到 Spring 自动注入，核心逻辑和 OpenFeign、MyBatis 的接口代理思想完全一致。
可能有人会说：“有现成的框架用，为啥还要手搓？” 答案很简单：<br>面试时，“会用” 只能拿及格分，“懂原理 + 能手搓” 才能拿 Offer；<br>工作中，遇到框架适配问题时，底层原理才是你解决问题的底气。<br>就像面试官问 “OpenFeign 为什么能直接调用接口”，你要是能把今天这一套手搓逻辑讲清楚，再对比一下 JDK 动态代理和 CGLIB 的区别，<br>他大概率会觉得 “这小子是真懂，不是背八股”。</span></pre>
</blockquote>
<p>以此表达作者对故乡的思念之情，对童年时光的怀念之情，爱国之情，对小日子的痛恨之情等等。</p>
</div>
